payload.title: Run any published procedure by key: papyrus procedures run <key> --input ...
payload.description: Today the CLI only runs procedures whose keys are in the hardcoded alias map corpora/papyrus-required-procedures.json, through purpose-built wrappers (assignments run-research, references summarize, ...). papyrus procedures has only seed-required, execute-tactus and policy. Add a generic run command that resolves any ProcedureDefinition by key, validates input against its parameterSchema, records a ProcedureRun, runs the current version and prints the run id and output. Found while building Distinctive's TTAB ruling-analysis procedure (PPY-8e13f6).
